title: lysimachia vulgaris subsp. davurica
intro: Lysimachia vulgaris subsp. davurica, commonly known as Ural or Russian golden- or yellow loosestrife, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the primrose family. The plant is valued for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and has been traditionally used to treat gastrointestinal issues and fever. The therapeutic actions of Lysimachia vulgaris subsp. davurica include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as lysimachio-side, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
